data.name: rtbInfo.Text
data.value:
Click CONNECT button to automatically connect to controller.
SCAN button will scan controller and report connected boards.
Select Auto Output Test and click TEST button to do a 'walking' output test of all connected boards.
Select Single Output Test and click TEST button to do a test of the output selected in the displayed box.
Show Saved Values displays the current settings in the Use Nightmode, PWM Setting and Timer Value boxes for the selected output.
